div.div:
worker candidates gate: running < min(machine.maxConcurrent, body.maxWorkers)
running = non-chief claimed only (machineRunningCount excludes kind=chief)
blocked workers stay pending (queue)

div.div:
chief candidates: exempt from both caps
full workers do not starve chief (gate closed = earliestWorker = +inf, chief loop runs)
chief never occupies a slot: me.runningSteps and waitingFor.running count workers only
